article_title: B.C. Reg. 163/2026 – BC Financial Services Authority
body:
Regulation: B.C. Reg. 163/2026
Made under: Financial Institutions Act
Published in: No. 17 – B.C. Reg. 163, October 6, 2026
Deposit date: September 29, 2026

B.C. Reg. 163/2026, deposited September 29, 2026, under theFINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS ACT[section 201.1]. Rule of the BC Financial Services Authority, dated March 16, 2026. The BC Financial Services Authority orders that, effective January 1, 2027, the attached Credit Union Capital Requirements Rules are made. — S. HEATH,Chair, Board of Directors. CREDIT UNION CAPITAL REQUIREMENTS RULES Part 1 – Interpretation and General Rule "Act"means theFinancial Institutions Act; "affiliate", in relation to a credit union, means an affiliate within the meaning of section 2.1 of theCredit Union Incorporation Act; "Canada Mortgage and Housing Corporation"or"CMHC"means the Canada Mortgage and Housing Corporation established under section 3 of theCanada Mortgage and Housing Corporation Act; "consolidated subsidiary"means a subsidiary of a credit union whose assets and liabilities are consolidated with those of the credit union under section 2 (1)[consolidated assets and liabilities]; "corporation"has the same meaning as in section 1 (1) of theBusiness Corporations Act; "credit risk weighted asset"means an asset weighted for credit risk in accordance with Division 3 of Part 5; "deposit taking institution"means any of the following: (d)	an extraprovincial trust corporation that is authorized to carry on deposit business; (e)	either of the following as defined in theCooperative Credit Associations Act(Canada): (i)	a cooperative credit society; (f)	an extraprovincial credit union; (g)	a deposit taking institution in a foreign jurisdiction approved by the superintendent; "depositor"means an individual or entity that has money on deposit with a credit union; "equity exposure"means an exposure that meets the criteria described in section 38[criteria respecting equity exposures]; "home equity line of credit"means a revolving credit that is secured by a residential property;

minutes_briefs.title: BC Credit Unions Face New Capital Requirements Rules Starting January 1, 2027
minutes_briefs.summary: The BC Financial Services Authority has issued B.C. Reg. 163/2026 under the Financial Institutions Act. This regulation creates new Credit Union Capital Requirements Rules that take effect on January 1, 2027. The rules set out how credit unions must calculate and hold capital, including definitions for credit risk weighted assets, equity exposures, and home equity lines of credit. The regulation was deposited on September 29, 2026, and published on October 6, 2026.
minutes_briefs.action_required: Credit unions should review the new Capital Requirements Rules and prepare their capital calculations and reporting to comply by January 1, 2027.

key_dates.label: BC Credit Union Capital Requirements Rules take effect
